description: We are ZERO POINT — SPHEREx Explorer, a team led by Yash Petkar with members Pratik Lokande and Eshaan Jadhav. We aim to build an interactive platform to explore real SPHEREx infrared observations and astronomical data for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome teammates skilled in astronomy, Python, AI/ML, data analysis, web development, and visualization. We value teamwork, curiosity, and scientific thinking.
